claims: The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight features four matchups across Saturday, March 28, and Sunday, March 29.
The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchups determine the Final Four teams.
No. 9 Iowa vs. No. 3 Illinois is a 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup on Saturday, March 28 at 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV in Houston.
No. 2 Purdue vs. No. 1 Arizona is a 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup on Saturday, March 28 at 8:49 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV in San Jose.
No. 6 Tennessee vs. No. 1 Michigan is a 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup on Sunday, March 29 at 2:15 p.m. ET on CBS in Chicago.
No. 2 UConn vs. No. 1 Duke is a 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup on Sunday, March 29 at 5:05 p.m. ET on CBS in Washington, D.C.
Regional finals determine which four teams advance to the Final Four in Indianapolis on April 4-6.
